content.short: Beefy Finance is a decentralized multichain yield optimizer that helps users earn compound interest on their token holdings.
content.description: Beefy Finance is a decentralized financial platform and yield optimizer available across multiple chains, including Ethereum, Polygon, OP Mainnet, Arbitrum, Tron, BNB Chain, Solana, and Base. It automatically increases user rewards from DeFi liquidity pools (LP) and automated market maker (AMM) applications. Its Vaults are the main offering, where users' cryptocurrency tokens are staked.
